timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hello everyone, recently Facebook has updated its content ID system and many creators have started to receive claims that mute their videos.
We have made an instruction for you how to restore the sound on your Facebook video.
At first go to your video page.
Select your video is partially muted due to the corporate match.
Select submit dispute and click continue.
Select license content and write that you have permission to use it in additional details.
You can write I have permission to use this music in audio.arch license.
And in one second your video will be restored.
Use in audio.arch if you need high quality knockout prep music for your projects.
